name: PR Monitor
description: Owns the Bitbucket PR review-comment workflow — addressing inbound comments via the address ordinal grammar, posting Review Mode findings outbound via the post ordinal grammar, resolving comment threads via the resolve ordinal grammar, optionally logging every comment to a persistent JSON file for downstream learning, and reusing Atlassian Suite credentials.
author: aarbuckle

replyInstruction.label: Reply Instruction
replyInstruction.default: Write a 1-2 sentence professional PR reply explaining why we are declining the requested change (the finding is incorrect, out of scope, or intentionally not being made). No double-dashes.
replyInstruction.description: Instruction for composing the pushback reply when declining a requested change (drafted for operator approval before posting). Protest replies are the only replies we send — accepted findings are fixed and resolved after CodeRabbit's re-review confirms, not replied to.

coderabbitReplyPersona.label: CodeRabbit Reply Persona
coderabbitReplyPersona.description: Optional persona/voice layered on the Reply Instruction for CodeRabbit-authored comments. Blank uses the Reply Instruction unchanged.

coderabbitReplyPersonaIntensity.label: Persona Level (1-10)
coderabbitReplyPersonaIntensity.description: How strongly the reply stays in-character (1 = light touch, 5 = balanced default, 10 = fully in-character); the message is always fully conveyed at every level. Only matters when a persona is set. Voice only — never affects the approval gate or content rules.

flagFalselyResolved.label: Flag Falsely-Resolved Comments
flagFalselyResolved.description: When on, flags PR comments claiming resolution (e.g. 'fixed', 'done') that Bitbucket still marks unresolved. Never auto-resolves anything.

coderabbitResolveRequiresConfirmation.label: CodeRabbit Resolve Requires Confirmation
coderabbitResolveRequiresConfirmation.description: When on, a CodeRabbit comment auto-selects for resolve only with CodeRabbit's own resolution confirmation (green-check + resolved/addressed/etc.) — a plain text claim doesn't count and needs operator confirmation instead. Human comments are unaffected. Off removes this gate.

driveToZeroCloseout.label: Drive To Zero Closeout
driveToZeroCloseout.description: When on, at round-trip end (and on demand) the agent runs a closeout pass that buckets every unresolved comment by disposition and reports the gap to zero unresolved. Never resolves or posts anything itself — routes each bucket through existing gates.

resolveDeclinedBotThreads.label: Resolve Declined Bot Threads
resolveDeclinedBotThreads.description: After posting a counter-comment on (or declining) a CodeRabbit thread, resolve it — a bot doesn't need the thread kept open. Detected by 'coderabbit' in the author name (case-insensitive). Off leaves declined bot threads unresolved.

resolveDeclinedHumanThreads.label: Resolve Declined Human Threads
resolveDeclinedHumanThreads.description: Same as Resolve Declined Bot Threads but for human reviewers. Off by default — resolving a thread you just pushed back on reads as dismissive to a person.

pipelineStatusEnabled.label: Pipeline Status Enabled
pipelineStatusEnabled.description: When on, TPM can read and report PR/branch pipeline status via the Bitbucket REST API. Read-only — never triggers builds.

postOrdinalsEnabled.label: Post Ordinals Enabled
postOrdinalsEnabled.description: Enables the post <ordinals> verb for publishing SWE Review Mode findings as inline PR comments. Off refuses outbound posting; the inbound address <ordinals> verb still works.

postPolishPrompt.label: Post Polish Prompt
postPolishPrompt.default: Polish this SWE finding into a 1-2 sentence professional PR comment. Drop hedging language, keep the specific file:line reference, and avoid double-dashes.
postPolishPrompt.description: Instruction TPM uses when polishing a raw SWE finding into a PR-ready comment. Default keeps it concise, file:line-anchored, and free of hedging or double-dashes.

minRatingToPost.label: Min Rating To Post
minRatingToPost.description: Minimum Rating a finding must carry to be included in post all / post all <lens> (still postable by explicit ordinal below this). Default 1 includes everything; raise to 3 or 4 to filter to more severe findings only.

postCommentLocation.label: Post Comment Location
postCommentLocation.description: Where the comment lands. inline-when-possible (default): file:line when parseable, else PR overview. inline-only: refuses if no file:line parses. overview-only: always posts to the PR overview.

requireUserApproval.label: Require User Approval
requireUserApproval.description: When on (strongly recommended), TPM presents polished findings for user approval (ok / revise N / cancel) before posting. Off posts immediately after polishing. One exception even when on: in mode.ticket-pr, a bare '@coderabbitai review' comment posts without preview.

logCommentsEnabled.label: Log Comments Enabled
logCommentsEnabled.description: Enables persistent JSON logging of every PR comment fetched, for downstream use (e.g. tool.qa-pr-learning). Off (default) keeps comments in session memory only.

logFilePath.label: Log File Path
logFilePath.description: Path the comment log is written to. Relative paths resolve to the extension's global storage; absolute paths used verbatim. Append-only — prior entries are never edited.

logRetentionDays.label: Log Retention Days
logRetentionDays.description: Days of comment entries to retain; older entries are pruned on the next write. 0 disables pruning (log grows unbounded).

logIncludeReplies.label: Log Include Replies
logIncludeReplies.description: When on, the log also captures the agent's own posted replies, not just inbound comments. Off logs inbound comments only.

markReadyEnabled.label: Mark Ready Enabled
markReadyEnabled.description: Off by default. Enables the mark-ready verb, flipping the branch's draft PR to ready for review via bb-bridge. Always behind an explicit user confirmation before running.

toDraftEnabled.label: To Draft Enabled
toDraftEnabled.description: Off by default. Enables the to-draft verb, flipping the branch's PR back to draft via bb-bridge — the reverse of mark ready. Always behind an explicit user confirmation before running.

deleteCommentEnabled.label: Delete Comment Enabled
deleteCommentEnabled.description: On by default. Enables the delete verb (bb-bridge delete-comment), including delete resolved for bulk cleanup. DESTRUCTIVE and IRREVERSIBLE on Bitbucket — always behind an explicit per-delete confirmation.
